name: toasts
drive: (()=>{const names=['Success','Info','Warning','Danger','With an action','Stays until dismissed'];const hit=[];for(const n of names){const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()===n);if(b){b.click();hit.push(n);}}return hit.join(',');})()

name: lookup confirm, row pending
drive: (async()=>{const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const i=[...document.querySelectorAll('input[aria-haspopup=grid]')][1];if(!i)return 'no lookup';i.focus();i.value='cloud';i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));let g;for(let n=0;n<40;n++){await w(150);g=document.getElementById(i.getAttribute('aria-controls'));if(g&&g.querySelector('tbody tr[aria-selected]')&&i.getAttribute('aria-activedescendant'))break;}if(!g)return 'no grid';i.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',bubbles:true}));for(let n=0;n<50;n++){await w(100);if(g.querySelector('tr[aria-selected=true]'))return 'pending';}return 'no pending row: active='+i.getAttribute('aria-activedescendant')+' expanded='+i.getAttribute('aria-expanded')+' rows='+g.querySelectorAll('tbody tr[aria-selected]').length+' connected='+g.isConnected;})()

name: stepper, step error flagged
drive: (async()=>{const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const set=(l,v)=>{const lab=[...document.querySelectorAll('label')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim().startsWith(l));const i=document.getElementById(lab.htmlFor);i.value=v;i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));i.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));};const next=()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('section button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='Next').click();set('Email','ada@example.com');set('Password','correcthorse');await w(300);next();await w(800);set('Workspace name','acme');await w(300);next();await w(1200);return document.querySelector('nav li[data-state=error]')?'flagged':'no error state';})()

name: split button menu open
drive: (async()=>{const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const t=document.querySelector('button[aria-haspopup=menu]:not([disabled])');if(!t)return 'no split toggle';t.click();for(let n=0;n<30;n++){await w(100);if(document.querySelector('[role=menu]'))return 'menu: '+document.querySelectorAll('[role=menu] [role=menuitem]').length+' items, focus '+(document.activeElement?.getAttribute('role')??'none');}return 'no menu';})()

name: message dismissed, live message shown
drive: (async()=>{const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const d=document.querySelector('.zen-message button[aria-label=Dismiss]');if(!d)return 'no dismiss';d.click();const f=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='Fail to save');if(!f)return 'no fail button';f.click();for(let n=0;n<30;n++){await w(100);if(document.querySelector('.zen-message[role=alert]'))return 'alert shown';}return 'no alert';})()

name: es-DO: split button menu open
drive: (async()=>{const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const t=document.querySelector('button[aria-haspopup=menu]:not([disabled])');if(!t)return 'no split toggle';if(t.getAttribute('aria-label')!=='Más opciones')return 'no translation: '+t.getAttribute('aria-label');t.click();for(let n=0;n<30;n++){await w(100);if(document.querySelector('[role=menu]'))return 'menu open, '+document.documentElement.lang;}return 'no menu';})()
